kicker: THE SCALE ISN'T THE WHOLE STORY
title: 10 signs you're losing *fat, not muscle*

items.head: Your lifts keep going up
items.sub: More weight or reps each week means the muscle is staying.

items.head: Belt looser, sleeves tighter
items.sub: Your clothes change before the scale does.

items.head: No 3PM crash
items.sub: Steady energy all day means you're eating enough.

items.head: You're full after meals
items.sub: You're not thinking about food between meals.

label: SIGN 9
head: You're losing 0.5 to 1 kg a week
sub: Any faster and muscle goes out with the fat.

label: RED FLAG
head: Your lifts drop every week
sub: You're eating your muscle. Add protein and cut slower.

pre: If most of these sound like you:
text: *Keep going.* The scale is the slowest sign of progress.

head: Save this for your *next cut*
sub: Check it before you panic about the scale.
